fields.value: Tall and handsome, with a noble bearing that initially reads as forbidding reserve.
Intelligent, loyal, discerning, proud, socially reserved, and initially too conscious of rank.
To act according to principle, protect those he loves, and eventually earn Elizabeth’s esteem without presuming upon it.
Wealthy owner of Pemberley; orphaned elder brother and guardian to Georgiana; nephew of Lady Catherine.
Romantic counterpart whose actions test and revise Elizabeth’s judgment.
Brother and guardian of Georgiana Darcy; nephew of Lady Catherine; cousin of Colonel Fitzwilliam.
Pemberley, Derbyshire; also spends time in London.
Learns to replace proud entitlement with humility, openness, and service expressed without expectation of reward.
Elizabeth: resisted love and moral catalyst. Bingley: close friend. Georgiana: protective brother. Wickham: former companion and antagonist.
